key_insight: FEALPy.CFD is a backend-agnostic, open-source Navier–Stokes solver that improves portability and performance across CPU/GPU hardware with minimal code changes.
engineering_relevance: It lowers the barrier to high-performance CFD development by providing modular, reusable components for building and testing incompressible flow solvers across heterogeneous systems.
method: Supports multiple backends: NumPy, PyTorch, and JAX
Enables seamless CPU/GPU switching with minimal code modification
Provides modular spatial discretization components for new algorithms
evidence_signal: Benchmark validation shows the implemented numerical schemes achieve their expected theoretical convergence orders, and backend selection delivers efficiency gains on suitable hardware.
watch_item: Performance and usability gains may depend on the chosen backend and the maturity of each backend's numerical and GPU support.
paper_title: A High-Performance, Cross-Platform Open-Source Solver for the Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations in FEALPy
